arrangement.name: intro
arrangement.notes: Kick only. Maybe a distant metallic sound in the background. This builds atmosphere and discipline in the crowd. The hat does NOT enter yet.

arrangement.name: build
arrangement.notes: Bass drone enters — a low sub rumble or mid-range industrial grind. Drive-type sound. Hats begin to fill — 16ths very tight.

arrangement.name: groove
arrangement.notes: First industrial texture enters. Could be a looping metallic sample, a distorted synth stab, or a noise layer. This locks in the hypnotic groove.

arrangement.name: breakdown
arrangement.notes: Drums drop. Only a held pad and texture remain. Very dark, atmospheric. Short — 8 bars max. The silence makes the kick re-entry hit harder.

arrangement.name: peak
arrangement.notes: Densest moment. Extra percussion layer, ride cymbal adds drive, bass louder, FX hits punctuate. Pad adds a slight harmonic wash. This should feel relentless but controlled.

arrangement.name: groove
arrangement.notes: Brief return to groove energy to begin wind-down. Texture filtering out.

arrangement.name: outro
arrangement.notes: Elements remove in reverse order. Bass goes first, then hats, then ride, until only kick remains — mirroring the intro.

arrangement.name: intro
arrangement.notes: Kick and hi-hat only. No bass, no chords. Pure rhythm to get dancers on the floor. Consider adding a subtle vinyl crackle or atmosphere.

arrangement.name: intro
arrangement.notes: Bass enters — minimal movement, mostly root note. Establishes key without revealing chords.

arrangement.name: build
arrangement.notes: Chord stabs enter — off-beat, sparse. Maybe 2 per bar. Energy starting to grow. Consider an open hi-hat upbeat to signal the groove arriving.

arrangement.name: groove
arrangement.notes: Full groove. Pad or organ holds the space. Chord stabs more frequent. Bass more melodic. This should feel DEEPLY satisfying. No lead yet — let the groove breathe.

arrangement.name: breakdown
arrangement.notes: Drums and bass drop. Pads hold the harmony over silence. Classic house breakdown. Maybe add a filtered vocal sample or piano riff. Maximum tension before the reintro.

arrangement.name: build
arrangement.notes: Kick re-enters (filtered, building). Snare roll in final 4 bars. FX riser sweeps upward. Prepare for peak.

arrangement.name: peak
arrangement.notes: Lead melody enters — piano lick, vocal hook, or organ riff. This is the emotional climax. Full energy, everything present. Lead should have space — don't crowd it with too many stabs.

arrangement.name: breakdown
arrangement.notes: Second breakdown, slightly shorter. Pure atmosphere. Signals outro is coming.

arrangement.name: outro
arrangement.notes: Drums and bass return but everything else strips away. DJs can mix out here. End with a final snare roll and open hat.

arrangement.name: intro
arrangement.notes: Chill atmosphere opening. Sample or vinyl crackle.

arrangement.name: groove
arrangement.notes: Laid-back groove enters. Drums feel slightly behind the beat.

arrangement.name: full_groove
arrangement.notes: Full arrangement. Live flute or vibraphone melody. World elements welcome.

arrangement.name: breakdown
arrangement.notes: Strip back drums. Bass and pads carry the vibe.

arrangement.name: peak
arrangement.notes: Warmest moment. All elements together with maximum feel.

arrangement.name: outro
arrangement.notes: Return to texture and atmosphere. Slow fade.

arrangement.name: intro
arrangement.notes: Start with Andean field recordings, distant guacharaca scrape emerging

arrangement.name: ritmo_entra
arrangement.notes: Cumbia rhythm enters — guacharaca, tambora, deep kick. Bass not yet.

arrangement.name: groove
arrangement.notes: Full cumbia groove with sub bass and synth pad stabs

arrangement.name: puente
arrangement.notes: Bridge — drop drums, focus on melody (charango/pan pipe) and atmosphere

arrangement.name: remate
arrangement.notes: Peak — all elements, maximum energy, percussion fills every 4 bars

arrangement.name: outro
arrangement.notes: Fade to percussion and field recordings, guacharaca last
